description: The old locking room, with a counter where the lever rods came down through the ceiling. A sign-in ledger lies chained open on it beside a kettle that's never been switched off. Lockers line the east wall, half of them missing doors. A painted arrow points up the stairs: BUNKS, FIVE FLOORS, FIRST COME. The wash is north.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to see who's coming. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it's doing it in plain view.
window.name: the front window
